## Shared Conventions

- Each handler file owns one logical route group — logic belongs in the owning handler, not in a central dispatcher.
- Keep routing dispatch (if/elif chains) in the base/router file; keep business logic in handler files.
- All handlers should proxy external API calls through the server to avoid CORS issues.

## Escalate to Source When

- you need exact request/response shapes for a specific route
- you are adding a new route (must update the routing dispatch and create or extend a handler file)
- you need to understand authentication or SSL passthrough logic
